paragraphs: International School of Management (ISM) is a private, state-recognised University of Applied Sciences in Germany, founded in 1990 in Dortmund. It has grown into a seven-campus network across Dortmund, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, Stuttgart and Berlin, with over 3,200 students. ISM is fully FIBAA-accredited and holds AACSB accreditation (since 2024), placing it among the small group of triple-quality German business schools.

ISM is consistently ranked among the top private business schools in Germany. The 2019 Wirtschaftswoche ranking placed ISM 4th among private universities and 14th overall for business administration. The 2023 CHE Ranking gave ISM top marks for support at the beginning of studies, graduation in due course, and work experience integration.

All English-taught Bachelor and Master programmes follow an international curriculum with a compulsory semester abroad at one of ISM's 188 partner universities in 43 countries. The student cohort is highly international, with strong intakes from Eastern Europe, Asia, the Middle East and Latin America. English-language pathways include B.Sc. International Management, B.Sc. Finance & Management, B.Sc. Applied Data Science, M.Sc. International Management, M.Sc. Finance, M.Sc. Logistics, M.A. Luxury & Fashion Management and a full-time / part-time MBA.

ISM combines a small-cohort, application-oriented teaching style with strong industry partnerships — including BMW, Lufthansa, Motel One, Deloitte and L'Oréal — giving students access to internships, dual-study tracks and real-world consulting projects throughout the degree.
paragraphsRu: International School of Management (ISM) — частный, государственно-аккредитованный University of Applied Sciences, основан в 1990 году в Дортмунде. На сегодня — сеть из 7 кампусов: Dortmund, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, Stuttgart и Berlin, более 3,200 студентов. Полная аккредитация FIBAA и AACSB (с 2024) — ISM входит в узкий клуб triple-quality немецких бизнес-школ.

ISM стабильно в топе частных бизнес-школ Германии. В рейтинге Wirtschaftswoche 2019 — 4-е место среди частных университетов и 14-е общее по business administration. CHE Ranking 2023 — top marks за support в начале учёбы, graduation in due course и интеграцию work experience.

Все англоязычные Bachelor и Master программы построены вокруг международного curriculum с обязательным семестром по обмену в одном из 188 партнёрских университетов ISM в 43 странах. Очень международный cohort — сильный intake из Восточной Европы, Азии, Ближнего Востока, Латинской Америки. Англоязычные направления: B.Sc. International Management, B.Sc. Finance & Management, B.Sc. Applied Data Science, M.Sc. International Management, M.Sc. Finance, M.Sc. Logistics, M.A. Luxury & Fashion Management, full-time / part-time MBA.

ISM сочетает small-cohort и application-oriented teaching с сильными индустриальными партнёрствами — BMW, Lufthansa, Motel One, Deloitte, L'Oréal — что даёт студентам интернатуры, dual-study треки и реальные консалтинговые проекты на протяжении всей программы.
